texts.label: text
texts.orig: There are three main types of SEO:
texts.text: There are three main types of SEO:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Programmatic SEO. The production of product pages, landing pages, and other web pages automatically generated from a database of information.
texts.text: Programmatic SEO. The production of product pages, landing pages, and other web pages automatically generated from a database of information.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Editorial SEO.
texts.text: Editorial SEO.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Articles, guides, and other content generated manually (written by a person) instead of automatically.
texts.text: Articles, guides, and other content generated manually (written by a person) instead of automatically.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Technical SEO.
texts.text: Technical SEO.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A website’s infrastructure, including site architecture, internal link architecture, category pages, tags, redirects, and page speed.
texts.text: A website’s infrastructure, including site architecture, internal link architecture, category pages, tags, redirects, and page speed.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Internal links are part of both editorial and technical SEO. As the name suggests, they connect one web page to another page or resource on the same website, internally, via hyperlink. Your site may also include external links, or backlinks, which connect a page on your site to a high-quality resource outside of your domain.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: The different types of internal links
texts.text: The different types of internal links

texts.label: text
texts.orig: You can use two types of internal links on your website:
texts.text: You can use two types of internal links on your website:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Contextual links. Hyperlinks within the body of a website’s content, such as blog posts, that lead to another page on the same site are contexual, driving deeper engagement by encouraging visitors to explore related topics and spend more time on your site. These links are more valuable for SEO because they connect pages and deepen context.
texts.text: Contextual links. Hyperlinks within the body of a website’s content, such as blog posts, that lead to another page on the same site are contexual, driving deeper engagement by encouraging visitors to explore related topics and spend more time on your site. These links are more valuable for SEO because they connect pages and deepen context.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Navigational links.
texts.text: Navigational links.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Menu links in a website’s header, footer, or sidebar that allow users to quickly find to other pages are for navigation. These links help users easily move through your website to find the content they seek.
texts.text: Menu links in a website’s header, footer, or sidebar that allow users to quickly find to other pages are for navigation. These links help users easily move through your website to find the content they seek.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Including both types of links in your internal linking strategy allows you to create a website that’s informative, easy to navigate, and optimized for Google and other search engines.
texts.text: Including both types of links in your internal linking strategy allows you to create a website that’s informative, easy to navigate, and optimized for Google and other search engines.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: The power of internal linking in SEO
texts.text: The power of internal linking in SEO

texts.label: text
texts.orig: In SEO, internal links are an often underappreciated lever for growth — a tool Ethan estimates more than 90% of websites aren’t utilizing. “Google is crawling the web and your site through links,” says Ethan. “And if you don’t have links, then Google doesn’t have paths to find all of your pages.”
texts.text: In SEO, internal links are an often underappreciated lever for growth — a tool Ethan estimates more than 90% of websites aren’t utilizing. “Google is crawling the web and your site through links,” says Ethan. “And if you don’t have links, then Google doesn’t have paths to find all of your pages.”

texts.label: text
texts.orig: So not only do internal links help SEO, but they’re actually make-or-break if you want your site to rank higher on search engine results pages (SERPs). Here’s what links do
texts.text: So not only do internal links help SEO, but they’re actually make-or-break if you want your site to rank higher on search engine results pages (SERPs). Here’s what links do

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Teach search engines about your website’s structure. Internal links allow search engine crawlers to index your site’s pages more effectively by showing how your content is interconnected. This helps the search engines understand the hierarchy of your content.
texts.text: Teach search engines about your website’s structure. Internal links allow search engine crawlers to index your site’s pages more effectively by showing how your content is interconnected. This helps the search engines understand the hierarchy of your content.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Distribute link equity.
texts.text: Distribute link equity.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: When you link out to another internal page, you pass some of the authority and credibility of the original page to the linked resource. This is how you distribute link equity (or “link juice”) throughout your site.
texts.text: When you link out to another internal page, you pass some of the authority and credibility of the original page to the linked resource. This is how you distribute link equity (or “link juice”) throughout your site.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Improve the user experience.
texts.text: Improve the user experience.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Internal links help users navigate your site more easily, improving the user experience and enticing visitors to stick around longer. In turn, a high-quality experience increases engagement, social shares, and backlinks to your website.
texts.text: Internal links help users navigate your site more easily, improving the user experience and enticing visitors to stick around longer. In turn, a high-quality experience increases engagement, social shares, and backlinks to your website.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Help target specific keywords.
texts.text: Help target specific keywords.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: By linking to pages that target a specific keyword, you signal to search engines which pages on your site are most relevant for search queries containing that keyword. Engines prioritize credibility and relevance in content, putting stronger content on SERPs, in turn generating more traffic and visibility for your site.
texts.text: By linking to pages that target a specific keyword, you signal to search engines which pages on your site are most relevant for search queries containing that keyword. Engines prioritize credibility and relevance in content, putting stronger content on SERPs, in turn generating more traffic and visibility for your site.

texts.text: Ethan’s 4-step guide to building an internal linking strategy

texts.label: text
texts.orig: If you’re looking to optimize your website but don’t have the human or budgetary resources to devote to highly specialized programmatic SEO, focus your efforts on the editorial side of things — that’s where internal linking really comes into play.

texts.orig: Use internal links to connect pages — the more, the better. (Ethan recommends at least 5–10 links per page.) Just be sure to use descriptive anchor text that’s relevant to the content it’s linked to.

texts.orig: The importance of human-generated content
texts.text: The importance of human-generated content

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Don’t underestimate the power of the written word — according to Ethan, editorial SEO has become more effective at driving traffic than programmatic SEO. “The way that you grow is with programmatic and with editorial SEO,” he says. “And I think editorial SEO, and by that I mean articles and content, manually written content, is underappreciated.”

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Whether you’re updating existing content or creating new material for your website as part of your digital marketing and internal linking strategies, you might be tempted to save time and resources by using an AI tool like ChatGPT. But although Ethan believes AI is useful for the parts of the content creation workflow that lead up to writing — such as extracting structure, identifying topics and subtopics, and performing keyword research — he cautions against using it for the writing itself.

texts.orig: “A lot of times, it’s indistinguishable from a human,” he says. “The problem is that you want the sentence to be factual.” And because GPT-3 works by crawling very large data sets and generating sentences similar to those it finds, the sentences it produces may or may not be accurate.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Google’s algorithm places a higher value on pages with quality, relevant content, so inaccuracies can have a negative impact on your site’s performance. And, more importantly, unreliable information can harm your users. “If I have cancer, and I’m researching cancer options, and this AI content suggests some treatment that isn’t a good treatment, that’s a big problem,” Ethan says.
